case.name: Multi-Domain Support Orchestrator
case.business_problem: Resolve customer support requests that can span billing, technical troubleshooting and account security - domains owned by separate teams/systems today.
case.desired_outcome: A single customer-facing conversation that transparently coordinates across domains without customers re-explaining themselves to each team.
case.quality_target: Correct domain routing and resolution, measured per domain's own success criteria
case.cost_constraint: Moderate - must stay below the current blended cost of multi-team human handoffs
case.regulatory_constraints: Account security actions require step-up verification; billing actions must be auditable
case.roi_notes: Illustrative assumptions, not measurements: Efficiency: removes manual handoffs between billing/technical/security teams for cross-domain tickets. Solution cost: higher than a single-domain assistant due to cross-domain coordination overhead.

option_scores.name: Single workflow with manual team handoff

tradeoff_notes: Billing, technical support and account security each have distinct ownership, tooling and risk profiles (security actions need step-up verification; billing needs its own audit trail) - collapsing them into one undifferentiated agent blurs exactly the boundaries that make each domain auditable on its own. A single workflow with manual handoff is safer but reintroduces the re-explaining problem this case exists to remove. Validate the added multi-agent coordination complexity is actually needed before committing - see the engine's own warning on this recommendation.
